user.title: Netatmo Presence (local)
user.description: Enter the camera's local address and its device key. The key is the secret path segment that every local API address contains, between the host name and the word command.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the camera, with no scheme
data_description.vkey: The secret path segment of the camera's local API

reauth_confirm.title: Device key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The camera at {host} no longer accepts the stored device key. Enter the current one.

reconfigure.title: Change the camera's address or key
reconfigure.description: Update where the camera is reached and the device key used to talk to it. Leave the key as it is if only the address changed.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the camera, with no scheme
data_description.vkey: The secret path segment of the camera's local API

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the camera. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the same network. {error_detail}
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected this device key. {error_detail}

abort.reconfigure_successful: The camera's address and key were updated.
abort.another_device: That address and key point at a different camera. Add it as a new device instead.

set_floodlight.name: Set floodlight
set_floodlight.description: Sets the floodlight mode and intensity in a single call.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: on forces the light, off disables it, auto lets the camera decide.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.description: Brightness of the floodlight, from 0 to 100 percent.

set_night_triggers.name: Set night triggers
set_night_triggers.description: Chooses which night-time detections switch the floodlight on while it is in automatic mode.

always.name: Always
always.description: Keep the floodlight on all night.

person.name: Person
person.description: Light up when a person is detected.

vehicle.name: Vehicle
vehicle.description: Light up when a vehicle is detected.

animal.name: Animal
animal.description: Light up when an animal is detected.

raw_command.name: Raw command
raw_command.description: Calls any command of the camera's local API and returns its response. Useful to explore firmware-specific endpoints.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Query-string parameters, as a key/value mapping.
